verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an HTTP Integration Server API with partnerUserID/partnerUserSecret credentials and OAuth2, but never mentions an official SDK or client library in any language. The GitHub repo is the Expensify app's own source code, not an SDK for building against the product. A raw API is adjacent to the story, not the official-SDK capability it asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
